meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的版本、配置、插件和命令链接,与最新源码对比,输出一份每条结论都附命令输出或文件证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告。只诊断,不改动你的安装和配置。
howto.when: 当你要 “doctor” 或健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、omo-codex 等,或 Codex 在安装/更新/改配置后行为怪异时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一遍 doctor,看看 LazyCodex 安装健不健康
say.note: 会输出带证据的 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告

say.text: 我更新 Codex 后行为不对劲,帮我查一下哪里出问题
say.note: 会逐项探测并附上证据

say.text: 检查我的 config.toml 和插件文件跟最新源码有没有偏差
say.note: 会把差异和对应路径列出来

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude checks local LazyCodex and Codex CLI versions, config, plugin payload and bin links against the latest sources, then returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report citing command output or a file for every verdict. It only diagnoses.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex or omo-codex, or Codex acts oddly after an install, update or config change.

say_en.text: Run a doctor on my LazyCodex install
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence

say_en.text: Codex has been acting weird since I updated it — check it
say_en.note: Probes the install and lists evidence

say_en.text: Check if my config.toml and plugin files drifted from latest source
say_en.note: Lists the differences and their paths
